# PathProbe

> A command-line network test tool for Linux and Windows.

PathProbe is a command-line network test tool. It has no graphical interface and no API. Every feature runs from a terminal: a Linux shell, or an Administrator Command Prompt or PowerShell on Windows.

Official website: https://getpathprobe.com/
Support: service@getpathprobe.com

## Features

- DHCP client simulation (DHCPv4 and DHCPv6), with custom MACs and VLAN tags, to test servers and relays
- Interface and link checks: list adapters, link speed and addresses; select an interface by name or MAC
- Subnet scans (ARP / IPv6), internet check, WAN address lookup
- ICMP traceroute bound to an interface
- Packet capture
- Flags results that break RFC/IEEE standards
- JSON output for scripts
- Static addressing

Use PathProbe only on networks you own or are authorized to test.

## Platforms

- Debian and Ubuntu (.deb, amd64 and arm64)
- Other Linux (.tar.gz, amd64 and arm64)
- Windows 10 and 11 x64 (installer or portable zip; some features require Npcap)
- macOS: coming soon

Every release includes SHA-256 checksums (SHA256SUMS).

## Pricing

- Free: $0. All core commands (DHCP, interfaces, env, scan, link, internet, whoami, traceroute, static addressing, and target). DHCP simulation up to 5 clients, none or a single 802.1Q tag, packet capture (pcapng), core RFC/IEEE standards checks, JSON output on interfaces, env, link, internet, whoami, traceroute, scan, dhcp status, and license status, the dhcp run final JSON summary, the automatic run log, NetBox/Nautobot inventory, tab completion and typo suggestions, copy a run as a command, clearer error messages, and the examples command.
- Pro: $9.99 USD, one-time purchase. Everything in Free, plus up to 1,000 simulated DHCP clients, QinQ (stacked VLAN tags), saved profiles with export, extra standards checks, live dhcp run --json events, --json on target, static, dhcp release/stop, and profiles, MCP server (use PathProbe from an AI agent), and scheduled profile runs with webhook alerts. 1 license = 1 computer, non-transferable. A license key is emailed after purchase and activated online once.

Checkout is handled by Paddle, the merchant of record. See https://getpathprobe.com/#pricing for the full comparison.

## Licensing

One license equals one computer and is non-transferable. Pro is activated online once with a license key emailed after purchase (`pathprobe license activate --key ...`).
